io.milvus.v2.service.vector.response.aggregation

Class AggregationBucket

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.response.aggregation.AggregationBucket

  • public class AggregationBucket
extends Object
    A single bucket in the result of a group-by search aggregation. Each bucket represents one group of matching entities identified by its AggregationBucket.KeyEntry key values, together with the entity count, aggregated metric values, top hits, and any nested sub-aggregation buckets.
